common_guards.rule: Only trusted physical state may support success; model self-report and command receipts are not outcome evidence.
NaN, infinity, missing required measurement, or unavailable required observation fails the trial.
The task must execute only in its declared source-backed MJCF scene.

definitions.continuous_dwell: Every stated terminal check holds at every required harness sample.
definitions.task_instance_parameters: Targets, reset, timeout, and scene-specific limits are frozen before a trial.

criteria.criterion_text: Forward displacement is at least 0.15 m and final planar speed is at most 0.05 m/s for 0.5 s.

checks.threshold_basis: EXPERIMENTAL_CONSERVATIVE_CHOICE; 0.20 m is the task target, not a model limit.

criteria.criterion_text: Lift joint displacement is at least 0.08 m.

checks.threshold_basis: EXPERIMENTAL_CONSERVATIVE_CHOICE; inside the Menagerie joint_lift range -0.5..0.6 m.

criteria.criterion_text: Gripper-slider Z displacement is at least 0.12 m.

checks.threshold_basis: EXPERIMENTAL_CONSERVATIVE_CHOICE; inside the 0..0.52 m arm-extend control range.

criteria.criterion_text: Wrist excursion is at least 0.20 rad.

checks.threshold_basis: EXPERIMENTAL_CONSERVATIVE_CHOICE; inside the -1.75..4 rad model range.

criteria.criterion_text: Gripper slide excursion is at least 0.01 m in each direction.

checks.threshold_basis: EXPERIMENTAL_CONSERVATIVE_CHOICE; inside the -0.005..0.04 m model range.
EXPERIMENTAL_CONSERVATIVE_CHOICE; inside the -0.005..0.04 m model range.
